items.title: Lambda alla spina
items.summary: This deck presents the evolution of AWS Lambda, focusing on two major features designed to run standard applications with less architectural overhead. Web Functions allow developers to deploy unchanged HTTP web servers (like Express) directly to Lambda, supporting concurrent requests per environment and billing for active CPU. Durable Functions enable long-running, multi-step workflows to be written directly in code with automatic state checkpointing and zero compute costs during pauses.

items.title: Quarkus Insights #265: Observability and Evaluation with Langfuse
items.summary: AI-infused applications demand a rethinking of our testing practices. Developers face a new class of challenge as LLMs become standard integration points in modern applications: non-deterministic behavior that traditional testing approaches were never designed to handle.Join Eric as he talks about testing strategies and evaluations in Quarkus and LangChain4j, as well as integrations with other open source tools.
